actual: Root actual QueryInfo now confirms core timeout0, interval600, both flags1, DPMS enabledtrue, level0, timeouts600/600/600, stateDisabled3. Original frozen r2 assumed DPMSfalse and correctly refused the mismatch. This r3 binds the root measured values and freshly queries them again before changing anything.
gtk: Production board ownership activates the existing five-second DisplayActivity.tick even while listening is paused.
helper: wake_display calls XResetScreenSaver, and DPMSForceLevel(0) only when DPMS is already enabled and level is nonzero. It does not set the core or DPMS timeouts or toggle DPMS enabled.
launcher: Line260 executes xset dpms force on during startup. This is a relevant startup call but this offline source review does not establish which client changed the observed enabled flag.
